node.title: Re: GRUB Append Parameter in-between Quotes
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ephemeric],

A little late but here's a try with Perl. This is like [hippo]'s [id://1171567|solution] but it adds the detection of whether the parameter has already been added or not. Personally I don't mind breaking up regexes into several regexes if it helps in thinking about the solution.

perl -pe 's/"\s*$/ transparent_hugepage=never"/ if /^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=/ && !/transparent_hugepage/' filename

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
